text:
maya: heads up — PR gate flakes again on quant-matrix, looks like autoscale/runner jitter. ran 3 PRs, one timed out, one hit artifact upload 504, one passed.
elias: can you paste the logs you saw?
maya: snippet: `runner: failed to pick up job: context deadline exceeded` and `eval-runner: shard startup took 32s` then `artifact upload failed with 504`
prashant: sounds like spot preempt / k8s scale down race. kube-provisioner kills nodes while jobs are being assigned.
sasha: we saw similar for nightly, but didnt expect PR gate to be on same fleet.
maya: we switched PR smoke to an 'on-demand' label for speed, but the full gha matrix still uses `runs-on: [self-hosted, eval-runner]` so PRs sometimes hit the heavy pool.
jun: proposed fix: split PR gating into two jobs — a tiny smoke on `ubuntu-latest` (fast quant check) and the full matrix only on pushes + nightly schedule.
prashant: +1. also: add `timeout-minutes: 30` and a simple retry loop with exponential backoff in the GH steps. for self-hosted we should add a preflight `curl` health check before claiming a runner so we fail fast and let GH re-route.
ci-bot: heads-up: build infra change — artifact TTL reduced from 14d -> 3d last week, that caused missing baselines for some nightly comparisons. see https://ci.internal/changes/8164
sasha: dashboards are also broken because the metric name changed from `eval.mean_accuracy` to `eval/mean_accuracy` in the exporter, so regression alerts didn't trigger.
maya: action items:
  1) split PR jobs (maya)
  2) update GHA matrix + add PR-only small-smoke job (elias)
  3) runner preflight + bump nodegroup min & scaleDownDelay (prashant)
  4) metric alias + alert fix (sasha)
  5) backfill artifacts/baselines (jun)
elias: I'll open a draft PR to change `.github/workflows/eval-pr.yml` — include a `smoke` job under `ubuntu-latest` and a reduced `matrix: include:` for PRs. example:
```
jobs:
  smoke:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - run: pytest tests/eval_smoke.py -k quant -q
  full_matrix:
    if: github.event_name == 'push' || github.event_name == 'schedule'
    runs-on: [self-hosted, eval-runner]
    strategy:
      matrix:
        model: [gpt-small, gpt-medium, gpt-large]
```
prashant: i'll update autoscaler to minNodes=2 and scaleDownDelay=5m, and add a fallback `on-demand` node pool for PRs labeled `on-demand`. will also add a liveness probe for the eval runner (k8s).
sasha: i can add a metric alias in the exporter to emit both `eval.mean_accuracy` and `eval/mean_accuracy` for 2 weeks, and update alerts.
jun: i'll run a backfill to recreate last 7 days of baselines and re-run the nightly compare.
maya: canary plan: roll changes in infra for one repo first, then flip main org workflows. quick sync Thurs 11am PT?
elias: got it, drafting PR now.
prashant: okay, i'll provision the fallback pool and bump quotas.
ci-bot: buildkite-bot created ticket BK-8124 for artifact backfill job.
sasha: ping me when PR is up and i'll adjust dashboard queries.
maya: thanks all :thumbsup:
elias: ack
prashant: ack
jun: ack
ci-bot: posting logs + build links in thread: https://ci.internal/builds/2237001122
